fullPrGate.skip: Explicit visible-window geometry test not run by default.
fullPrGate.scope: Gate predates the final guard-before-bind follow-up; that follow-up is covered by the subsequent native preview test.

nativePreview: Actual hub hover decode, repeated-hover no reload, continuous frame updates, different-device bitmap drawing, stop/restart, resize, shutdown/reinitialize, no render/upload while stopped, no device reacquisition after shutdown, no hover persistence, actual hub extraction/private/normal/canceled persistence all passed.

hiddenUi.scope: Real native main playback and hub hover; active/recent preview retention, expired teardown during main playback, continued playback time and lazy restart. No visible-window resource evidence.

idleProbe: Real metadata and shell-thumbnail probes release mapping/job/events/process handles between requests, retain outcome, and restart lazily; gate passed. No process RSS saving claimed from nominal mapping capacity.
hiddenRenderer: Text/layout/sized-format/WIC caches clear and rebuild with same text dimensions, capture pixels and shared factories/context. Two-waiter generation notification invariant passed; not real blocked-producer integration.
package: All10 manifest payload files were checked by byte length and SHA256. No publication.
remaining: Fresh resource and coarse output comparisons for this frozen executable are recorded separately; these hidden correctness checks do not prove broad superiority over VLC.
